findings.title: Candidate-list fit chip missing for current review with score_percentage 0 (Poor fit) — likely falsy guard on 0; outside assigned SPEC 2.5 scope, report-only
findings.expected: Agnes Sipes' Inbox row shows a 'Poor fit' chip like Carl Dietrich ('Weak fit') and Emilee Hand ('Good fit') do — her PlatoTab shows a current Poor fit review and 'Poor fit' is a list filter option.
findings.actual: Agnes Sipes' row renders no fit chip (no aria-label/title element in her row; Carl and Emilee rows have 'Weak fit'/'Good fit'). GET /api/v1/jobs/29092/job_applications?hiring_stage=203589&page=1 returns her ai_job_application_summary_status as {status: 'current', score_percentage: 0, ai_job_application_summary_id: 2537, headline present} — the data is served; the chip does not render only for the score_percentage: 0 case (Carl 29.41 and Emilee 88.24 render).
findings.evidence: API comparison across the 3 Inbox rows: Agnes {current, 0} no chip; Carl {current, 29.41} chip; Emilee {current, 88.24} chip. Consistent with a falsy guard treating a legitimate 0 score as absent (pipeline CLAUDE.md failure pattern 13 class). Chip logic predates the re-score feature and is not pinned by SPEC 2.5, hence MED report-only rather than HIGH; PlatoTab itself displays Poor fit correctly. Screenshot /tmp/qa-run-3-l5/agent-6/inbox-agnes-sipes-plato-regenerate.png shows the row without a chip alongside the Poor fit review.
